controller.action_law: turn=clip(2.5*heading_error,-1,1); forward action is zero until |heading_error|<0.10; approach uses 0.20/0.15, applies [-1,0] at distance 0.45 until forward velocity <=0.01, finishes at 0.05, then escape repeats [-1,0] along the same line
controller.escape_waypoint: none; preserve heading and drive backward

distance_semantics: public nearest agent-origin-to-hazard-center distance capped at 3
